name: SANTA RICCIO (RIZZO)
bioAdditions: The San Mango parish burial index has the entry on 8 September 1668 (S1), matching the tree's death date.
funFacts: Burials in 1668 (49) and 1669 (52) were several times the normal level: an epidemic year in San Mango.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Tree data match an indexed San Mango parish entry (derivative index of a primary register; image online but not read by me).
